elaine (seceng): Heads-up — planning an admin housecleaning next Tue 10am PT. Scope: remove ownerless admin bindings, validate KMS grants, and tidy stale svcacct permissions. Short window, low-risk approach.

mike (sre): +1. can you share the ownerless query?

elaine (seceng): sure, here's what I'm running against our entitlement view:
```\nSELECT role, member, last_seen FROM iam_bindings
WHERE role LIKE '%admin%' AND last_seen < '2023-01-01';
```
For AWS quick filter:
```\naws iam list-roles --query "Roles[?contains(RoleName, 'Admin')]" --output json
```
Primary triage: owner tag, last activity, KMS key grants.

samir (infra): FYI found 8 KMS key grants in prod without owner metadata. I'll attach audit links to the GH ticket.

jordan (ops): @samir pls add remediation commands. I can run them in the window.

samir (infra): remediation plan (staging test first):
```\n# add ops as temporary admin
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/KR/cryptoKeys/key \
  --member=user:jordan@example.com --role=roles/cloudkms.admin
# remove orphan svcacct
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/KR/cryptoKeys/key \
  --member=serviceAccount:old-service@example.com --role=roles/cloudkms.admin
```

audit-bot: Reminder: review created 'admin-housekeep-2024-05'. Owners auto-notified.

elaine (seceng): action items:
- samir (infra): produce full owner attribution for prod KMS keys by EOD Fri
- jordan (ops): perform owner outreach and log responses (Mon)
- mike (sre): prep rollback runbook and smoke tests in staging
- everyone: review assigned rows in the housekeeping spreadsheet https://tiny.example/housekeep

mike (sre): rollback quick-restore snippet (use only if removal breaks svc):
```\ngcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJ --member=serviceAccount:old-service@example.com --role=roles/owner
```

samir (infra): question — for ML model-serving service accounts, treat as permanent by default? want to avoid accidentally removing live keys.

elaine (seceng): yes. model-serving svcaccts are on the whitelist. we'll cross-check against the 'critical-svcs' list and escalate anything not matched before removal.

jordan (ops): noted. i'll standby for the window. ping @jordan if any failures.

elaine (seceng): policy: if audit logs show 0 usage in 180d AND no owner, we auto-flag for owner outreach but do NOT auto-delete. manual approval required for any removal.

mike (sre): i'll open the PR with the remediation scripts and link it here.

samir (infra): linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/321 (adds discovery + remediation scripts).

elaine (seceng): perfect — final runbook will be posted Friday. window Tue 10am-12pm PT.

jordan (ops): :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Checklist updated — added 'owner-response' evidence requirement to the review ticket.

elaine (seceng): thanks all. we'll keep this low-friction and document everything in the ticket.
